visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young adult male with short black hair and a small fringe sits at a wooden desk positioned against a neutral beige curtain. He is wearing a black shirt with a white grid pattern over a plain white T-shirt, with a blue pen tucked behind his right ear. He gazes intently at an open textbook while holding a blue ballpoint pen, appearing physically strained and frustrated with his English self-study. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit white room where the man is lounging on a white couch. He wears the same grid-patterned shirt paired with light blue denim shorts and white socks with red stripes. He holds a smartphone horizontally, his facial expression relaxing as he lazily scrolls through the screen content. (3) A sharp close-up shot of the smartphone screen reveals the Jella! app interface. The screen displays a vibrant promotional page for a 2025 Autumn Study Group, featuring orange and yellow autumn-themed graphics and cartoon illustrations. A finger is seen interacting with the touchscreen, navigating through various text blocks and schedule previews. (4) Back at the desk, the man is now actively participating in an online lesson. A Dell laptop is open in front of him, displaying a video of a middle-aged male teacher. The man is diligently writing notes on a document with his blue pen, showing a focused and studious demeanor. (5) Following a black transition screen with white text, the man reappears at the desk. He has changed into a light blue collared shirt with a white collar. He holds his blue pen up, smiling broadly at the camera with a sense of pride and accomplishment as he speaks fluently. (6) A montage sequence showcases various study materials, including a mobile app's practice screen, handwritten PDF notes, and a weekly schedule displayed on a computer monitor. The man is later seen in front of a bright yellow background, pointing upwards and gesturing energetically as graphic overlays for discount codes and brand logos appear on screen. (7) In the final shot, the man is back at the desk, smiling warmly into the camera lens while holding his pen, conveying a successful and encouraging conclusion to his learning journey.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with the primary male speaker, Ethan, exhibiting a low pitch and a slow, somewhat hesitant speech rate as he phonetically spells out the English word 'prohibit.' His tone is visibly frustrated and tired. The acoustic environment is exceptionally clean and dry, resembling a quiet room with no background music or ambient noise. (2) A clear, heavy sigh of exhaustion is heard, immediately followed by the introduction of an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic-pop background music track featuring bright guitar strumming and a soft rhythmic beat. Ethan’s voice shifts to a casual, conversational tone as he talks about taking a break to browse his phone. (3) As Ethan discovers the learning app, his vocal arousal increases significantly. His pitch rises and his tone becomes energized and surprised. 'Eh, what is this study group?' he exclaims. The background music maintains its steady, cheerful rhythm, supporting the sense of excitement and newfound motivation. (4) A secondary male voice, identified as an English teacher from an online video, is heard with clear, professional articulation and a moderate pitch. Ethan is heard mimicking the teacher's phrases. The interplay between the two voices and the persistent background music creates a layered, virtual classroom acoustic texture. (5) Ethan's voice returns to the lead, now characterized by high confidence and smooth, fluent prosody. He recites an English idiom with an upbeat and proud tone. The background music continues to provide a positive, supporting bed. He expresses satisfaction with his learning progress using a satisfied inflection. (6) The final phase features Ethan delivering a high-energy, fast-paced promotional script. His tone is enthusiastic and professional, with a higher intensity and loudness. The background music swells slightly in volume, concluding with a bright, digital 'Jella!' brand jingle that punctuates the end of the recording.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Struggle -> Discovery -> Transformation -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional endorsement for Jella!, an online language learning platform. It uses a relatable 'before and after' narrative where the creator starts struggling with traditional self-study and finds a more effective, scheduled way of learning through the Jella! app's study groups. The goal is to drive registrations for their upcoming autumn courses using discount codes.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the 'Jella!' app, verbal recommendation, and the provision of a specific discount code 'kuanjella250'.
